test_downcast: test the pybind11 tagbased polymorphic downcast by creating a zoo of animals and verifying type resolution
create_zoo: create a zoo of polymorphic animals including Labrador, Dog, Chihuahua, Cat, and Panther using the tagbased_polymorphic module
test_bark: test the bark method on dog animals in the zoo to verify polymorphic behavior and custom sound output
test_purr: test the purr method on cat animals in the zoo to verify polymorphic downcasting works for feline types
test_excitement_property: test the excitement property on a Labrador animal by decrementing its value and asserting the result
